newsitem.title: USA: Fed to decide rate policy without June jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Fed to decide rate policy without June jobs data.

text.p: Federal Reserve policymakers will have to decide interest rate policy next week without the benefit of key June jobs data.

A spokesman for the Bureau of Labor Statistics said the policymakers will not get an advance look at the numbers before they are released on Thursday. "They will not see any numbers before the official release," he said.
The central bank's policy-making Federal Open Market Committee is meeting on Tuesday and Wednesday. It is widely expected to decide to leave interest rates unchanged.
